60200.description: WE'RE LIVE! Join the most professional & fan-favorite streamer to explore Terra! Live stream mishaps? Not a chance!

60214.description:
After being recently discharged from military service and just drifting through life, Hanbin Ryu is suddenly transported to another world. However, his “guide line,” the system bestowed upon him to help with his survival and growth, was filled with errors, causing him to be stuck in the tutorial stage for over 20 years. When he is finally released from this personal hell, he finds everyone has turned against otherworlders like him. Just how will this low-level, super-tutorial newbie survive?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

title.native: 彼女フェイス THE ANIMATION

60221.description:
Leo is a boy genius inventor. Aquro is a water type Elemon (H2O) created by Leo. Elemon are creatures born from the Elemon Blender. They are mysterious beings with the power of the elements! “ELEMON” opens up an exciting world of science and adventure, anchored by the friendship of Leo and Aquro as they explore an entire universe of unique Elemon!

(Source: Toei Animation)

60223.description:
Kaya-chan attends Hanamugi Kindergarten, and she has an incredibly strong sixth sense. She secretly beats up the ghosts that stalk her friends and family, but in turn, she’s treated like a troublemaker since nobody understands her strange behavior. Everything changes when her teacher, Chie, discovers her secret. Kaya-chan's fists will go flying at any sinister spirits that show up!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
60223.hashtag: #カヤコワ #カヤちゃんはコワくない
synonyms: คายะจังไม่กลัวหรอกนะ

title.native: カヤちゃんはコワくない

60226.description:
Seiichirou Kondou, a salaryman approaching his 30s, gets caught up in a holy maiden summoning ritual and is transported to a parallel world called Romany Kingdom. Having worked day and night, he developed the mindset of a corporate slave and even demanded work in this new world, which landed him an accounting job at the Royal Accounting Department.

During his hectic days rebuilding the accounting department, Seiichirou came across a nutritional tonic that wiped away any fatigue. Thanks to the tonic, Seiichirou's chronic ailments and exhaustion completely disappeared, leaving him overjoyed. But because he had no resistance to the world's magic, the side effects put his life in danger!

The only way to survive was to have someone with magic help accustom his body to magical energy, so with no other choice Seiichirou entrusts himself to Aresh, captain of the Third Royal Order, known as the Ice Prince.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
60226.hashtag: #異世界の沙汰は社畜次第 #いせしゃち

60230.description:
A prequel to the Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED FREEDOM movie.

After the collapse of the Destiny Plan proposed by Dullindal, which would have decided people's fates based on genetics, Cagalli, the chief representative of the Orb United Emirates, has been working to bring about a peaceful new order by establishing a global peace monitoring agency called COMPS (Pronounced Compass).

C.E.74. The great war is over, but Shinn has yet to decide what course he should follow. Then a mobile suit which has survived many past battlefields is transferred from ZAFT to COMPS's temporary base on Onogoro Island. That night, however, the Strike Freedom Gundam is stolen by persons unknown.

To stop the situation from escalating, to recover the stolen machine, and for the sake of everything they must protect, Shinn and his comrades once again throw themselves into battle...

(Source: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM Site)

title.english: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO
title.native: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM ZERO
title.romaji: Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO

60233.description:
The protagonist, Lin Feng, was originally a genius robotics engineer. To enhance the capabilities of his super-powered robot, he painstakingly unearthed a mysterious ancient treasure from the abyss—the Eye of the Ancestral Dragon. Just as he was about to transfer the Eye's energy into his robot, the divine power within was accidentally activated, triggering a spacetime vortex that transported Lin Feng to an ancient god-like continent that revered martial arts, where he was reborn.

The reborn Lin Feng had his memories of his past life sealed, becoming an ordinary person who only awakened a healing-type martial soul. He faced cold shoulders and even had his fiancee break off their engagement. His fiancee's clan, determined to eliminate any future threats, ruthlessly attacked and killed him. In this moment of crisis, Lin Feng awakened his memories of the Eye of the Ancestral Dragon and was overjoyed to discover that its divine power had successfully fused with his super-powered robot. Subsequently, with the robot's assistance, he gradually mastered the Eye of the Ancestral Dragon's power and embarked on the path to becoming a powerful figure.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)

60235.description:
On the Tianwu Continent, the strong commands the weak. The young master of the Feng family Feng Hao, owns a unique physique but was mistakenly thought to be a failure in cultivation. He was chastised and humiliated constantly because of that. A chance meeting transformed him completely and ultimately altered his fate. He contoured his body with rare gems and eventually achieved invincibility. He was set on the path to conquering the void and rampaging through the universe!

(Source: BiliBili Comics)
synonyms: ศึกปรปักษ์

60246.description: Four participants playtest a virtual reality game that is still under development. The game uses AI simulated NPCs and system dynamics to generate a world with features not created by the developers, and perhaps beyond human understanding.

60248.description: A civilization that disappeared in the dust, the ancient bosses sought their own way to become emperors. Jiang Hao, a modern young man who was originally a chess piece, stepped into the prehistoric wilderness in order to find the whereabouts of his father. With his incomplete "power bank" totem, he fought with people, from primitive tribes to the mysterious ancient city, he fought his way out; he fought with the earth, crossed the wilderness, hunted ancient beasts, and learned the ancient and mysterious totem witchcraft from the beasts; he fought with the sky, and the magic light from the sky suddenly appeared, wanting to devour this magnificent six wastelands. He went upstream, ignited himself, turned into the sun, and fought with the devil! He was shaking the world, but he didn't know that the shackles of fate had already trapped him, and his father's smile was still lingering.

60249.description:
In a special scientific experiment, Jun Changxiao arrives at the Starfall Continent and inherits a small sect. He must build it into the number one sect within 100 years. He works hard to establish the sect, recruit disciples, and leads them to build houses, farm, and maintain peace. The disciples have different personalities, but under Jun Changxiao’s leadership, they form a warm and harmonious family, supporting each other and growing together.

(Source: Yuewen Animation English YouTube channel)

60253.description:
16-year-old Yukito Kirihara lives with his 14-year-old sister Sana, who he treasures more than anyone else. But when an ogre shows up outside of his window looking for Sana (a shocking event in its own right), Yukito leaps to save her—and is killed. He's offered the promise of reincarnation by a mysterious woman, who gives him a character sheet in a mysterious book. But when Yukito sees Sana in there, too, he sets off to find her, and save them both—even if he only has 1 hp with which to do it!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.english: Otherworldly Munchkin: Let's Speedrun the Dungeon with Only 1 HP!
title.native: 異世界マンチキン ―HP1のままで最強最速ダンジョン攻略―
title.romaji: Isekai Munchkin: HP 1 no Mama de Saikyou Saisoku Dungeon Kouryaku

60254.description:
Kiyoko Yoshida is an overanxious class representative who can’t help but worry about Tsuyoshi Yano, who sits beside her. Tsuyoshi comes to school covered in bruises, and as Kiyoko tends to him day after day, the two draw closer. Where will Kiyoko’s feelings take her? Will Tsuyoshi’s life ever be normal? A romantic comedy between an anxious girl and a boy who’s always injured is about to begin!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

60255.description:
Arne Neuntöte is a vampire detective who manipulates supernatural powers. Lynn Reinweiß is a nobleman’s daughter who loves vampires. Their worlds should never have crossed, but they join hands to solve a bloody mystery.

In the darkest of nights, Lynn finds herself in desperate need of help. Then she wanders into the mysterious city of "Lügenberg", where non-humans live. Lynn's world changes drastically when she encounters "Arne", a vampire who is called "the worst" in the city. And tonight, a new "murder case" has occurred. What is the truth behind the bizarre incidents that take place in a world where humanity and the bizarre intersect?

"Come on, human. You may dance merrily under the crimson moon.”

(Source: The Case Book of Arne Steam page)
60255.hashtag: #アルネの事件簿 #アルネアニメ化

60260.description:
The best hotels must meet certain standards, including the finest cuisine, ways to relax, and entertainment. Of course, they also need the best selection of weapons, reliable ways to falsify one’s identity, and ways to dispose of evidence. In this hotel at the border of death stand two concierges, Ikuro Hoshi and Sara Haizaki. What kinds of requests will the assassins have for them next?

(Source: Crunchyroll)
60260.hashtag: #ホテル・インヒューマンズ

title.native: ホテル・インヒューマンズ

60273.description:
"In a world where words mean power, they risk all that they stand for".

The final Division Rap Battle begins. 48 different patterns, 16 new songs and 7 possible endings.

This film will be Japan's first-ever interactive movie, where the audience's choices will change the development and outcome of each screening. The story unfolds differently based on the audience’s decisions, offering an entirely new participatory cinematic experience.

(Source: Hypnosis Mic Youtube Channel, edited)

60285.description:
The legendary former hitman Tarou Sakamoto has thwarted numerous assassins after an enormous bounty on his head was issued. But he cannot seem to catch a break and simply take it easy with his beloved family. A mysterious and infamous figure known as Slur has brought a group of insane death row inmates to Japan, who hold back from nothing to eliminate their targets.

Sakamoto is not the only target—the criminals have been assigned to kill various other people, including the new hires at Sakamoto's convenience store, Shin Asakura and Lu Shaotang. The situation escalates even further when the Order, a group of the most skilled Japanese assassins, becomes involved. As the inmates begin wreaking havoc, Sakamoto and his allies must remain vigilant for the sake of everything they hold dear.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Note: The series is streaming a week in advance on Netflix Japan starting with episode 2 released alongside episode 1.
synonyms: サカモト デイズ 2クール

60289.description: In this fantasy world, where everyone is human and retains their animal features, the inhabitants live a peaceful life. For his next book, novelist Su Bai comes to the hometown of his good friend Avena Nanxia, a terraced village far away in the mountains, where he meets the lively and lovely Cu Nian Nian. Farming, picking, eating, catching fish ...... The daily life in the mountains and fields is always interesting.

60293.description:
To escape his tiring job, weary Murata finds escape at a nearby baseball stadium. While the games are thrilling, it’s Ruriko, the gyaru as cold as the beer she serves but secretly a sweetheart, who keeps him coming back. As her first regular, Murata discovers the warmth behind her frosty demeanor, and their hilarious, heartwarming encounters light up the ballpark and maybe even their hearts.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
60293.hashtag: #ボールパークでつかまえて #アニメボルパ

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

60297.description: On an unknown continent, there is a city called Satellite City No. 9. In this city, a screw straightening worker named Rui Li at the screw factory gradually realizes the unreality of the city in her monotonous daily work. With the help of a mysterious character named “Anull”, Rui Li gains the superpower of “transformation” and becomes the thief “Sirius”, secretly taking action to escape from here. When the truth of the world finally unfolds before her eyes, Rui Li discovers that her real battle has just begun...
synonyms: A War between Humans and AI
